# Build the planb64 forwarding tool.
#
# The verifier supplies CXX and CXXFLAGS from the environment; honour them
# and only fall back to sensible defaults when they are absent.

CXX ?= g++
CXXFLAGS ?= -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic
CPPFLAGS ?=
LDFLAGS ?=
LDLIBS ?=

TARGET := planb64
SOURCES := planb64.cpp

.PHONY: all clean
all: $(TARGET)

$(TARGET): $(SOURCES)
	$(CXX) $(CPPFLAGS) $(CXXFLAGS) -std=c++17 $(SOURCES) $(LDFLAGS) $(LDLIBS) -o $(TARGET)

clean:
	rm -f $(TARGET)
